response.changelog:
Pixel OS v2.1.3-b4 — Opt-In iOS Style UI Beta on Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• 1:1 Apple iOS 26 Phone, Keypad & Live Call Screen (IosDialer v1.7.6-ios26): completely eradicated third-party modded iCall 26 (zero LITEAPKS/ad popups, zero bloat Setting tab) and shipped our clean-room 90Hz Liquid Glass Phone + Telecom InCallService in /system/priv-app with Hooke-spring sliding 5-tab Liquid Glass capsule (Favorites, Recents, Contacts, Keypad, Voicemail), 1:1 iOS 26 circular Keypad, and live wallpaper-blurred Call Screen (IosCallActivity)
• Polished iOS 26 Messages (IosMessages v1.7.5-ios26): promoted to /system/priv-app with RoleManager SMS verification (zero false 'Set Default' header overlap), single docked Liquid Glass Search + Compose bar, clean ChatHeader avatar/pill geometry, and live Audio Call button for dialable threads
• Fixed Home Screen Left/Right Swipe Cross-Flash & Top Status/Notification Bar Pull-Down + Smooth 90Hz Lock Screen Pull-Up
• Compact Wireless Patch OTA (< 80 MiB — no 1.81 GB full system re-download required!)
• Fixed Websites Not Opening in Chrome, Brave & Chromium Browsers + Out-of-the-Box 4K60 Gyro-EIS3 Video Stabilization
